SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT DOC_NAME , TARGET AS TARGET , KEY_1 AS KEY_1 , KEY_2 AS KEY_2 , NVL(KEY_3,'1') AS KEY_3 , NVL(KEY_4,'0') AS KEY_4 , NVL(KEY_5,' ') AS KEY_5 FROM APPS.KEPTRXL WHERE DOC_NAME = 'REQ' AND IF_FLAG = 'N' ORDER BY DOC_NAME, KEY_1, KEY_2
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT 'SMT2' AS BUYER , 'KA' AS SITE , 'XX' AS PLANT , REQ_QUOTATION_NO AS QUOTATION_NO , '$G_RS.KEY_3$' AS QUOTATION_SEQ , NVL(REVISION,'0') AS REVISION , 'C' AS STATUS , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') AS ADD_DATE , ITEM_NUMBER AS BUYER_ITEM_NO , ' ' AS DESCRIPTION , ITEM_DESC AS SPECIFICATION , ITEM_UOM AS UNIT_MEASURE , MAKER_NAME AS MAKER_NAME , 0 AS UNIT_PRICE , '$G_RS.KEY_5$' AS ADD_USER_ID , REQ_USER_NAME AS REQ_USER_NAME , ' ' AS REQ_USER_DEPT_NAME , REQ_USER_PHONE AS REQ_USER_TEL_NO , REQ_USER_EMAIL AS REQ_USER_MAIL , TO_CHAR(REQ_CLOSE_DATE,'YYYYMMDD') AS CLOSE_DATE , TO_CHAR(REQ_CLOSE_DATE,'HH24MISS') AS CLOSE_TIME , REQUEST_QUANTITY AS ITEM_QTY , ' ' AS REMARK FROM APPS.V_KEP_REQ WHERE REQ_QUOTATION_NO = '$G_RS.KEY_1$' AND ITEM_NUMBER = '$G_RS.KEY_2$' AND NVL(REVISION,'0') = '$G_RS.KEY_4$'
UPDATE APPS.KEPTRXL SET KEY_6 = to_char(SYSDATE,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') , IF_FLAG = 'Y' WHERE DOC_NAME = '$G_RS.DOC_NAME$' AND TARGET = '$G_RS.TARGET$' AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.KEY_1$' AND KEY_2 = '$G_RS.KEY_2$' AND NVL(KEY_3,'1') = '$G_RS.KEY_3$' AND NVL(KEY_4,'0') = '$G_RS.KEY_4$' AND IF_FLAG = 'N'
